name: tibyan
description: تِبْيان | Tibyan — AI-powered trusted Islamic knowledge retrieval platform

scripts.build: npm run build -w @tibyan/contracts && npm run build -w @tibyan/api && npm run build -w @tibyan/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspaces --if-present && npm run ai:lint
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @tibyan/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run test --workspaces --if-present && npm run ai:test
scripts.ai:lint: node scripts/py.mjs -m ruff check services/ai && node scripts/py.mjs -m ruff format --check services/ai
